[hr][/hr]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45173238/eb388353bff095ab887ccba0db93b4852844ded0.png[/img]

[h1]Story💦[/h1]
For many years, the village believed that [the goddess must be a virgin, otherwise the power will disappear]. When Reese's magic went out of control, the villagers began to suspect that Laleer had tasted the forbidden fruit.
That's right, the goddess did have an underground relationship with you. Laleer didn't dare to express her passionate love for you, and while suppressing it, she developed a dark side of "jealousy"
She was jealous of Reese and would use Reese, but Laleer was kind by nature after all...
[hr][/hr]
[h1]Lady Goddess! ❤️‍🔥[/h1]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45173238/0f13978465aab475a144aa2959582f2efaad7c78.png[/img]Why did you deliberately call me like this again?
I've already told you to just call me Laleer when there's no one else around. We're clearly at a negative distance...🤭 (whispering)
Someone's here. Come to my room tonight and we'll talk more
[h1]The future I want💌[/h1]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45173238/bf4cb0d6a3f303db04b3fbdd5e03fafe784230bb.png[/img]I hope there will be no more disease and death in the village, and everyone will be rich and happy. That would be great
My selfish thought is that they won't need the goddess anymore...then, can we get married, have kids, and stay together forever😐️
[h1]Hobbies👁️‍🗨️[/h1]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45173238/be41341de6b8782a36764407a8c7c59ad813a621.png[/img]My hobbies...are you still not clear?
If I don't do those things, I'll just read books. The library in the temple is still well stocked.
I like books. They can make me forget my troubles for a while and immerse myself in another world.

[h1][If... I'm not a goddess, how good it would be][/h1]
Laleer's life used to be like a stagnant pool of water. She repeated prayers, blessings, and healing every day, and was just a tool for the village.
The moment she met love, she began to waver. The girl was in love, her anxiety and expectations, all her desires came from you.
Solve her desires or watch her fall into the vortex of lust? Does Laleel's power disappear after losing her virginity? The pure and dissolute Laleel~her mystery is waiting for you to reveal.

[i]The voice of prayer sounded in the distance, Reese sat with her eyes closed. She insisted on praying every day even in the distant forest.
"Lord Laleer, please forgive Reese for tasting the forbidden fruit...❤️"[/i]
[h3]It's the little witch 🧙‍♀️, we are saved! [/h3]
[b]There are three characters in this game, and the story will also take place in the background of the fictional magic world.
Maomao will introduce the first character to you today! It is the little witch "Reese" who is very popular in the previous works.
This is a story about the growth and conflict of the little witch. [/b]
[h3]💗Story💗[/h3]
[b]Since childhood, Reese has been a loyal believer of Laleer. Her worship of Laleer almost reached the point of blind trust, and she placed all her faith, hope and life on Laleer.
Her abilities far exceeded her cognition, which also caused the magic power to often exceed her control.
The villagers were more afraid of her than disliked her. [/b]

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45173238/4e30a025c842e0c0aaded541f66211e29d68288c.png[/img]
Identity: Little witch❣️
Measurements: 92 (g)-65-85
Personality: Lively and sunny little believer, simple and easy to deceive❣️
Hair color: Long white hair
Eyes: Red eyes reveal her unique talent in magic
Clothing: Witch hat, Gothic style clothing highlight her magical identity
Body shape: About 158cm tall, petite and a little fleshy❣️

[h3]😲It turns out that she is really a witch! [/h3]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45173238/91d20ebc0edcaf0fc4d6404a7c34c6a354436dc3.png[/img][i]😑Hmm... (Thinking), I didn't know before!
My memory of this is a bit fuzzy, I can only remember some of it when I heard Lord Laleer narrate some of the past. Fortunately, no villagers were hurt, it's really fortunate that Lord Laleer was here! (Starry eyes)🤗Lord Laleer is really amazing!
Laleer: At that time, there were still villagers who fell and got injured because of the magic explosion and hurriedly ran away. Well, but this is indeed not Reese's fault[/i]

[h3]😮What are you doing recently? [/h3]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45173238/9851160f95f4d0b45558c60dd041e65d8ab1d20e.png[/img][i]I am learning to control magic!
Since I discovered powerful magic, Lord Laleer has let me move into the forest hut. One day, I can leave after I can control magic~ (mumble) jThank you, I have made a lot of progress recently! [/i]

[h3]🤤Hobbies[/h3]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45173238/a0939dca83e250ea149a5f101396311b78752a8b.png[/img][i]I don’t know~
There is nothing to do in the forest. I guess I can climb up the trees to pick fruits, because I can see the village from the trees. I can only pass the time by observing everyone (shrug)
Villagers: 🤧I always feel like there is a peeping Tom...[/i]

[h1][Are you my savior...🤕][/h1]
[b]The girl’s magic power is closely related to her body. Whenever she has a strong desire, the magic will go out of control. This powerful magic makes this village no longer able to accommodate her. Her blind loyalty may also lead to her being betrayed by the people she trusts at a critical moment... Fortunately, you are kind-hearted and will not watch her get hurt.
Reese's ending will be rewritten by you! [/b]

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45173238/43f7334102d2d22746a0c585d8752357bf07aa8e.jpg[/img]
[b]Hello everyone~ I am Maomao,
a game planner of [LovelyGames] (hard life, huh?)
I mentioned before that I would start publishing development logs,
but because Maomao has many responsibilities (faraway),
I have always had no time and opportunity to report to you all.
This time, "Contract Girlfriend" will open a new milestone!!![/b]

[h1]📌 Initial concept and gameplay design[/h1]
At first, this project was a sudden idea (not really),
while making "Hot And Lovely Waifu XXII" At the same time,
considering that this gameplay exists in several games, plus the frequent feedback from everyone...
Sure enough‼ ️We must consider how to expand the gameplay of Candy Crush❗️
There are many ideas～～～
Relatively, we need to consider factors such as feasibility, fun, R&D cycle, technical requirements, production costs, etc. 。 。
For example, "adding combat elements" sounds very interesting,
there are many actual cases of competing products to refer to,
relatively, this requires increasing fixed costs,
not to mention sunk costs,
what's more terrible is that it will conflict with everyone's favorite "one-click skip" design ❌
In addition, if the level difficulty is too high, the gaming experience of some players will also deteriorate,
unlocking CG will also be difficult, which may not be very pleasing.
Rack your brains and think about it... 。 。
At this stage, we are still trying to find fun ways to play ✔

[h3]📌 More feasible ideas[/h3]
1️⃣ Enhance the interactivity between CG and the game
The primary purpose is that many players are concerned about the "problem of the separation between gameplay and CG".
This part of the problem can be big or small. After all, we all know that the goal of playing the game is of course to eliminate the game!
Since we know that everyone is looking forward to it, we will naturally respond to everyone's needs as much as possible when the situation allows.
We also want to do this, and we all hope to get better.
The latest idea is to unlock the CG by eliminating the CG pictures covered by bricks.
This promotes the integration of "three eliminations + elimination to unlock CG + standing picture performance" elements,
which can not only connect the gameplay with the CG (as shown in the attached picture),
render the game atmosphere, and enhance the motivation to play. The overall feasibility is relatively high at this stage.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45173238/2c592a8dc6da143c2bc2e441172388cd60ee77a9.png[/img]

[h3]2️⃣ Enhanced story and CG unlocking system[/h3]
Let CG theater be the core of positive feedback for the game.
Each character will have two short stories to create a character. Each story can unlock three CGs, and there are six CGs in total (still two modes: plot + free). We are still continuing to optimize this part. Some specific ideas are being considered and implemented. We only provide them to you for practicality. [h3]3️⃣ Optimization of female character interaction design [/h3] As a gentleman's game, character design (each XP) must be carefully considered. "Character introduction, scene interaction, character interaction" three points of entry. First of all, there should be an appropriate homepage interface. When the mouse moves into the heroine's portrait, we strive to have a variety of emotional reactions to meet the player's exploration and interaction needs. At the same time, we appropriately add information next to it to let players further understand the character. The overall setting is a kind of "immersive atmosphere"! Is it the kind of experience that you can experience with your girlfriend by paying the corresponding money? [/i]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45173238/3a2891d509a1e938b1933f937f8bb2c9942ca177.jpg[/img]

notes.title: "Fairy Biography 6: Revenge" will be launched on Steam on August 9, 2024!
notes.notes:
[b]Fairy Biography 6: Revenge will be launched on Steam on August 9, 2024. [/b]

This game uses a relaxing and puzzle-solving find-the-difference game as a medium to tell you a fantasy story - about the struggle for power between different races on this continent, the baptism of blood and the abyss of desire.
There are also new characters to bring you a brand new experience!

If you are interested, you may click on the store page below to quickly purchase and play!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2937990/Fairy_Biography_6__Revenge/

[hr][/hr]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982679/f73ffab99bb5259cb6ac2a93d13862b4f7f476c5.png[/img]

This story takes place on a fantasy continent where various races live.
Humans, werewolves, vampires, succubi... they were not willing to live in peace in a corner, so the war started, the smoke filled the air, and the flames of the power struggle burned on the earth.

In the end, the vampire king won, but he was on the throne, but he spent his days drinking and partying.

The seeds of crisis quietly sprouted, and this continent is about to usher in an unprecedented disaster.
But perhaps, this will be an opportunity to reshuffle the cards between races; perhaps, the continent will enter a new era because of this.

And what did the people on this continent do and what price did they pay for this struggle for power and honor?

The outcome is uncertain, and everything is a variable.
All of this will be witnessed by you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982679/7a9931643e4c0c618eead4a1df187a2e25549ce6.png[/img]

This is a puzzle game of finding differences.
In the game, you need to find all the differences between two pictures related to the story by comparing them.
Each level has 3 differences. When all the differences are successfully circled, the next level will be unlocked. After unlocking all levels, you can get the whole beautiful CG and gradually explore the true story of the whole game.

Which race will win in the end, and what kind of adventures will they have in the story?
This is an extreme test of the player's observation and concentration. Try to experience the complete story through all levels!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982679/8228bed586e320117efebce6178705c6398d3a4e.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Original world view and story of the imaginary continent
[*] Different characters of different races
[*] A large number of rich and beautiful CGs
[*] Interesting and casual games, simple and enjoyable
[*] One-click skip
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982679/39090a161b2286d1147eeff6a24ac280213b57fb.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982679/0c7bafedf393ce932bb5e9c1913a05cb4c7cbe53.jpg[/img]
The one talking to the human leader Alinda is...
The elegant and sinister diplomat from the neighboring country?

She seems to have an unclear relationship with Alinda - after all, Alinda can give everything for the interests of the human camp.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3028000/Joy_Life_4/

A new neighbor has moved in next door to you. She has creamy skin, always has a sweet and energetic smile, soft hair hanging down the side of her neck, and a graceful figure below...

notes.notes:

[h3] If you encounter any problems in the game, you can send me a private message or add me as a friend~[/h3]

[b]This is a dark fairy tale:
The most insignificant people in this world are human beings, but they rely on God's favor and coexist with alien races. The human king has long lost his right to speak. The torture of successive illnesses makes him miserable, but in the end, the seeds he planted will bear fruit. Guo, it was a curse from the devil. It seems that the gods can no longer favor him this time.
He once again made an agreement with the devil. If he sacrificed his son with divine power, he would be spared.
So new announcements were posted everywhere in major towns and villages:
The king became seriously ill not long ago, and he needed his children to accompany him and share family happiness while he was dying.
The news spread on a large scale and soon reached the village farthest from the main city. Mia, who had lived a self-sufficient life for a long time, immediately learned the news. She was the illegitimate daughter of the king and a peasant woman.
Her roommate Luna listened to the people in the village talking about "becoming a new princess overnight" and "flying on a branch and becoming a phoenix" and secretly laughed.
On the eve of Princess Mia's ascension to the throne, she and her roommates went to the forbidden forest and traded their most precious souls with the devil.
The last person to be sacrificed was the dying old king who had no leadership ability and would help Mia become the new ruler.
Of course, these things will only rot in her stomach. As long as Mia can succeed, she will give everything...[/b]

Stay tuned:
